caveat: Verify the concrete package pinout; unavailable pins are rejected by the core masks.
data_quality_note: Initial support targets the Seekfree STC16F40K128 LQFP64 board and ISP ID F7E0 (Beta), with GPIO, UART1 and Timer0 timekeeping only. flash_bytes is the nominal 128 KiB address-map span 0xFE0000-0xFFFFFF, not a claim of contiguous usable Flash. The ISP catalog separately reports total=124 KiB and code=120 KiB for F7E0. Beta user Flash is two separate 60 KiB banks, 0xFE0000-0xFEEFFF and 0xFF0000-0xFFEFFF. The current build uses only the upper 60 KiB bank, including reset HOME at 0xFF0000. Never fill or program the intervening 0xFEF000-0xFEFFFF hole. EDATA is 8 KiB, including the 256-byte DATA/IDATA compatibility window; XDATA is 32 KiB at 0x010000-0x017FFF. The Seekfree board example selects a 30 MHz ISP-configured IRC and P5.2 LED; this MCU variant does not change oscillator settings or assume a built-in LED. ADC is intentionally unavailable until its separate STC16 register layout is implemented. setjmp/longjmp and pdata are outside the initial C++ support boundary. Source is the STC-authored 2020-12-17 manual and STC16Fxx.h distributed by the board manufacturer.
